items.text: Ngosuku uMose alimisa ngalo itabernakele, waligcoba, walingcwelisa kanye nezitsha zalo zonke, ne-altare nezitsha zalo zonke, waligcoba, walingcwelisa;
izikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, izikhulu zezizwe ezaziphezu kwababalwayo, zanikela ngomhlatshelo;
Baletha umhlatshelo wabo phambi kukaJehova, izinqola eziyisithupha ezivalekile nezinkabi eziyishumi nambili; inqola yezikhulu ezimbili nenkabi; bakuletha phambi kwetabernakele.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Kuthathe kubo, ukuze bafeze inkonzo yetende lokuhlangana; uyakunika amaLevi, kube yilowo nalowo ngokomsebenzi wakhe.
UMose wazithatha izinqola nezinkomo, wazinika amaLevi.
Wanika amadodana kaGereshoni izinqola ezimbili nezinkabi ezine ngokomsebenzi wawo.
Wanika amadodana kaMerari izinqola ezine nezinkabi eziyisishiyagalombili ngokomsebenzi wawo phansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari indodana ka-Aroni umpristi.
Kodwa amadodana kaKohati akawanikanga lutho, ngoba inkonzo yendlu engcwele eyayingowawo yayiwukuthwala emahlombe awo.
Izikhulu zahlabela ukunikezelwa kwe-altare ngosuku lokugcotshwa kwalo, yebo, izikhulu zanikela ngomhlatshelo wazo phambi kwe-altare.
UJehova wathi kuMose: “Bayakunikela ngomhlatshelo wabo wokwahlukanisela i-altare, yilowo nalowo isikhulu ngosuku lwaso.
Owanikela ngomhlatshelo wakhe ngosuku lokuqala kwakunguNahesoni indodana ka-Aminadaba wesizwe sakwaJuda.

Umnikelo wakhe wawuyisitsha esisodwa sesiliva, isisindo saso sasingamashekeli ayikhulu namashumi amathathu, nomganu owodwa wesiliva wamashekeli angamashumi ayisikhombisa ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele; zombili zazigcwele impuphu ecolekileyo exovwe namafutha njengomnikelo wempuphu.
Isipuni esisodwa segolide samashekeli ayishumi, sigcwele impepho;
ijongosi elilodwa ithole lenkomo, inqama eyodwa, iwundlu lemvu elimnyaka munye kube ngumnikelo wokutshiswa;
inqama eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono;
Okomnikelo wokubonga nakhu: izinkomo ezimbili, nezinqama eziyisihlanu, nezinqama eziyisihlanu, nezimvu zamaduna ezineminyaka emihlanu ubudala; lokho kwakungumnikelo kaNahesoni indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Ngosuku lwesibili uNethaneli indodana kaSuwari, isikhulu sakwa-Isakare, wanikela.

Ngosuku lwesithathu u-Eliyabe indodana kaHeloni, isikhulu sabantwana bakwaZebuloni, wanikela;

Lokhu kwakungukwahlukaniselwa kwe-altare mhla ligcotshwa yizikhulu zakwa-Israyeli: izingqwembe zesiliva eziyishumi nambili, nezindebe zesiliva eziyishumi nambili, nezindebe zegolide eziyishumi nambili;

indishi eyodwa yesiliva yayingamashekeli ayikhulu namashumi amathathu, isitsha ngasinye singamashekeli angamashumi ayisikhombisa; zonke izitsha zesiliva zazingamashekeli ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu amane ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele;
Izinkezo zegolide zaziyishumi nambili, zigcwele impepho, zinesisindo esingamashekeli ayishumi ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele; lonke igolide lezinkezo lalingamashekeli ayikhulu namashumi amabili.

Zonke izinkomo zomnikelo wokushiswa zaziyizinkunzi eziyishumi nambili, nezinqama eziyishumi nambili, nezimvu zamawundlu ezinomnyaka munye eziyishumi nambili neminikelo yazo yokudla, nezinqama zibe ngumnikelo wesono eziyishumi nambili.

Zonke izinkomo zomnikelo wokubonga zaziyizinkunzi ezingamashumi amabili nane, nezinqama ezingamashumi ayisithupha, nezimpongo ezingamashumi ayisithupha, nezimvu zamawundlu ezingamashumi ayisithupha ezinomnyaka munye. Lokhu kwakungukwahlukaniselwa kwe-altare, lase ligcotshwa.
UMose esengena etendeni lokuhlangana ukuba akhulume naye, wezwa izwi lokhuluma kuye livela esihlalweni somusa esiphezu komphongolo wobufakazi phakathi kwamakherubi omabili; wakhuluma kuye.
